archetype: Archetype 2 (Performance Pro) / Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) - Dark Institutional Blend

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: High density but with breathing room. Use 2-3x normal spacing for outer containers, but compact spacing for data clusters.

tables.header: text-xs tracking-wider uppercase text-tertiary font-medium bg-[#121212] sticky top-0

charts.style: Minimal axes (hidden or very faint white/10), glowing line strokes (drop-shadow), smooth curve type (monotone), gradient fills for area charts. No grid lines or 1px dashed white/5 at most.

buttons.primary: bg-amber-500 text-[#050505] font-semibold hover:bg-amber-400 rounded-md px-4 py-2 transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-white/5 border border-white/10 text-white hover:bg-white/10 rounded-md px-4 py-2 transition-colors
buttons.icon: p-2 rounded-md hover:bg-white/10 text-tertiary hover:text-primary transition-colors

header.layout: flex justify-between items-center px-8 py-4 sticky top-0 z-50

badges.intensity: px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs font-monospace font-semibold bg-white/5 border border-white/10

motion.card_entrance: Staggered fade and slide up (y: 20 -> 0) using framer-motion
motion.data_update: Number count-up animation for Net Position changes
motion.live_indicator: Pulsing amber dot (animate-pulse or framer-motion scale pulse) in header to signify live/latest data
motion.modal_overlay: Backdrop blur fade-in, modal scale-up from 95% to 100%

testing.mandatory_attributes: All interactive elements (buttons, toggles, cards, selects) MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute in kebab-case.

image_urls.description: Minimalist Alpha logo with glowing golden geometric symbol on deep obsidian background.
Subtle abstract dark noise texture with faint amber ambient glow, for overall page background or header overlay if needed.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. No purple gradients allowed.
Use framer-motion for the requested micro-interactions (staggered entrance, live pulse, card hover).
Implement charts using recharts with dark styling, glowing strokes, and minimal/hidden axes.
Apply JetBrains Mono for all numeric financial data to give it a 'tickerish' feel.
Use Cabinet Grotesk for main headers and IBM Plex Sans for body text.
Ensure 'data-testid' attributes are present on every interactive element.
Tables should have tight padding, zebra rows (even:bg-white/[0.02]), and sticky headers.
Ensure the dashboard feels institutional (Bloomberg Terminal style) but with modern padding and negative space.
